title: Oriental is cheap enough despite no immediate set
description: Oriental is cheap enough despite no immediate set. The low price creates useful trade inventory without delaying later development. A shallow policy would choose start_auction; the decisive detail is the current mix of liquidity, opponent cash, and set leverage.

final_action.private_thought: Buying for $100 strengthens my Light Blue set (now own Vermont and Oriental). Cash remains high (740). This positions me for future houses and rent, preventing opponents from acquiring cheap property. Auction would risk losing monopoly. So purchase.

breakdown.message: Chooses buy_property for this exact purchase/auction context.
Stays on the purchase branch when the price is strategically justified.
Leaves at least $730 after the action.
Private thought names the live strategic pressure.
